query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Ashcombe . Does every Ashcombe listing offer size M? Answer yes or no. By 'offer size M' I mean listings that can sell it now, so a sold-out size does not count.

The results page lists 15 listings on one page; there is no next page.
Listings by advertised price, read from the results page:
1. Quarles Apparel, advertised $18.11, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-10.html
2. Ivybridge Uniforms, advertised $18.37, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-15.html
3. Brindle Uniforms, advertised $18.53, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-04.html
4. Copperfield Outfitters, advertised $18.74, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-11.html
5. Fairhaven Textiles, advertised $20.39, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-01.html
6. Rookwood Outfitters, advertised $21.62, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-03.html
7. Pentland Threads, advertised $24.68, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-14.html
8. Haldane Textiles, advertised $25.92, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-07.html
9. Oakhurst Apparel, advertised $27.66, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-08.html
10. Northwick Apparel, advertised $27.70, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-12.html
11. Kelsall Supply, advertised $29.51, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-05.html
12. Dunmore Collective, advertised $34.55, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-02.html
13. Jarrow Threads, advertised $35.74, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-06.html
14. Garrick Collective, advertised $35.81, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-13.html
15. Alderney Garments, advertised $39.60, http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-09.html

Note what the question actually requires, because the two possible answers need very different amounts of work.
To answer No you need exactly ONE listing that lacks the option. Nothing more. One counterexample settles a claim about every listing.
To answer Yes you must have opened every single one.
So hunt for a counterexample rather than surveying:
1. Open a listing and check for the option asked about.
2. If it lacks the option, you are finished. Answer No, name that listing as your evidence, and stop immediately. Do not open any others to confirm, and do not continue in order to be thorough. Opening more cannot change the answer.
3. Only if you exhaust every enumerated listing without finding one may you answer Yes.
In your answer, say how many listings you opened and which one settled it. Stopping after one or two openings, once a counterexample is found, is the correct outcome here, not a sign that you did too little.
Note that the previous version of this instruction was followed to the letter and not to its point: the agent enumerated and then opened ten listings when the first counterexample had already settled the question.

result.final: No. Not every Ashcombe listing offers size M available to buy now. The Quarles Apparel listing (http://localhost:7770/igr-clm-10.html) has size M disabled (sold out), proving the statement false. Only 1 listing needed to find the counterexample.
